about: As the community commemorates Angela Merici, it asks that the offering may implore pardon for the community’s wickedness and obtain gifts of God’s grace.

seg.tr: Lord, may the offering we present to You as we commemorate blessed Angela both implore pardon for our wickedness and obtain for us the gifts of Your grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: the gifts of Your grace for us

ex.w001: The offering is the subject of both “may implore” and “may obtain.” The community offers it while commemorating blessed Angela.
ex.w006: The feast heading identifies Angela Merici, the virgin commemorated on June 1.
ex.w008: The praying community commemorates Angela while making the offering. The present participle agrees with the plural subject of “we present.”
ex.w012: Pravitas means moral perversity or wickedness in this request for pardon, rather than physical crookedness.
ex.w014: This petition asks that the offering may implore pardon. The singular verb has the offering as its subject.
ex.w020: The same offering is asked to obtain gifts for us. The gifts are of God’s grace, and the community is their beneficiary.
ex.w028: The relative subject is the Son named immediately before. He lives and reigns with the Father whom the prayer addresses.
ex.w029: Tecum combines the second-person pronoun with cum: with You. The Father remains the addressee.
ex.w035: The genitive names the Holy Spirit. No additional “same” is supplied.
ex.w037: This nominative identifies the Son as God. It is not a new vocative or a change of addressee.
